title: 1/3-2/3 Conjecture
exact_target: Does every finite partially ordered set with an incomparable pair have two elements whose relative order occurs with probability between one-third and two-thirds in a uniformly chosen linear extension?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1488 (COMB-001). CC BY 4.0.
Emily J. Olson and Bruce E. Sagan, \emph{On the 1/3--2/3 Conjecture}, arXiv:1706.04985v2 (2018), Section 1, definition of linear extensions and Conjecture 1.1.
